process.title: Streamlined project management from planning to handover
process.lead: We deliver every project by integrating engineering planning, quality control, and on-site coordination into a single, efficient process.

steps.title: Pre-Construction Planning
steps.body: Project scope, quantities, site conditions, schedules, and logistics are thoroughly planned before any work begins on-site.

steps.title: Engineering Coordination
steps.body: Structural execution, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) layouts, and all other disciplines are managed in full alignment.

steps.title: Site Execution
steps.body: The construction process is carried out under the direct supervision of our site engineers, adhering strictly to project specifications and quality standards.

steps.title: Quality & Safety Control
steps.body: Material compliance, workmanship quality, health and safety protocols, and schedule tracking are monitored systematically.

steps.title: Final Checks & Handover
steps.body: Following technical verification and the completion of all necessary documentation, the project is fully delivered to the client.

about.title: SARL Igloo Yapi Construction
about.credential: Category 6 Professional Qualification and Classification Certificate
paragraphs: Founded in 2018 by Civil Engineer Adem Talay, SARL Igloo Yapi Construction is a Category 6 certified general contractor specializing in residential, commercial, mixed-use, and civil infrastructure projects across Algeria.
Operating from its head office in Bir Khadem, Algiers, the company manages every stage of a project under one roof—from planning and site execution to technical coordination and turnkey delivery.

With a strong team of civil engineers, architects, site managers, technical staff, and skilled field crews, we provide reliable, well-organized, and quality-driven solutions for both public institutions and the private sector.

proofs.title: Category 6 General Contractor
proofs.body: Holds the official professional qualification and classification certificate required to undertake large-scale residential, commercial, and infrastructure works.

proofs.title: Expert Technical Team
proofs.body: Supported by a solid organizational structure comprising civil engineers, architects, site managers, and specialized field crews.

proofs.title: Residential & Mixed-Use Expertise
proofs.body: Offers extensive engineering and field experience in multi-family housing, premium villas, commercial zones, and infrastructure civil works.

footprint.title: Active Operations Across Four Wilayas
footprint.lead: We operate across four different regions with completed and ongoing projects spanning Algiers, Tipaza, Mostaganem, and Boumerdes.
